## Verdict summary

**No.** The tree cannot honestly claim "exact same logic as VICE" for VIC-20. Disk evidence shows a **lockstep-oriented subset**: selected bus/geometry/color rules match VICE and are cited; large modules (sound, live IEC, tape/userport/lightpen, interlace, mid-line color timing, full draw pipeline, IEEE, snapshots, most carts) are **Missing**, **Stub/MVP**, or **Invented**. The on-disk audit already rejects the Exact claim (`docs/audit-vic20-vs-vice-2026-08-07.md` lines 282-297). Session claims that everything is Exact, that `Mos6561` is a full `vic-cycle`+`vic-draw` port, that 10s CPU lockstep proves video, or that carts are real VICE ports are **false**.

---

## Chip-by-chip matrix

| Area | VICE | Managed | Status | Why not Exact |
|------|------|---------|--------|---------------|
| **CPU** | `vic20cpu.c` `CLK_INC` + maincpu | `Mos6502` + `SystemClock` Phi2 | **Partial** | Shared 6502; lockstep-hardened slices only. Not a line-for-line maincpu export. |
| **Bus / open-bus** | `vic20bus.c`, `vic20memrom.c` | `BasicBus` last-data + V-bus latch | **Partial** | Selected rules (BASIC/KERNAL no last-data; chargen refreshes) match. Full C/V-bus not proven as Exact for all paths. |
| **Mem map** | `vic20mem.c` (~630 lines), `vic20io.c` | `Vic20SystemRam` + ROMs + overlays | **Partial** | BLK install map matches xvic tokens. Full `mem_conf`, VFLI, cart banking matrix incomplete. |
| **Color RAM** | `colorram_read/store/peek` in `vic20mem.c` | `Vic20ColorRam.cs` | **Exact** (those three rules) | 4-bit store; read OR `VBusLastData&0xF0`; peek no side effect. VFLI color banking **Missing**. |
| **VIC-I cycle** | `vic-cycle.c` (~460 LOC): open_v/h, fetch FSM, interlace, lightpen, memptr | `Mos6561.Tick` | **Partial** | Rough control-flow skeleton exists. **No** interlace, lightpen schedule, full `vic_cycle_do_fetch` memory map (VFLI/unconnected), `no_fetch` idle refresh. `LatchColumns` eagerly mutates live `_textCols` (VICE only latches `pending_text_cols`). |
| **VIC-I draw** | `vic-draw.c`: full line buffer + `display_xstart`, `drawing_table`, half-char / old_mc/old_aux, raster cache | `DrawRasterLine` | **Partial / Invented crop path** | Std/MC table rules partially ported. **No** `half_char_flag`, **no** `old_mc_border_color` / `old_auxiliary_color` mid-char path, **no** raster cache. Paints into **pre-cropped** normal FB with `originX = _displayXStart` instead of VICE full `screen_width*PixelWidth` line + crop (`vic.c` `vic_set_geometry` uses full `screen_width * VIC_PIXEL_WIDTH`, canvas `display_width * VIC_PIXEL_WIDTH`). |
| **VIC-I mem/regs** | `vic-mem.c`: char height, sound store, lightpen/pot, mid-line color changes | reg array + height + raster encode | **Partial** | Raster encode `$9003/$9004` matches. Char height 8/16 from bit0 present. Sound/lightpen/pot/mid-line `raster_changes_*` **Missing**. |
| **VIC-I sound** | `vic20sound.c` (~508 LOC) | comment only: "stored only" | **Missing** | No `IAudioChip` on VIC-20 builder. |
| **Palette** | `data/VIC20/PALette.vpl` + `vic-color.c` YUV/CRT | static RGB in `Mos6561.Palette` | **Exact** RGB for that vpl; **Partial** overall | RGB samples match (`97 2A 2E` etc.). No YUV/CRT/alternate vpl. |
| **Geometry/timing** | `vic-timing.h/.c` normal/full/debug/none | normal-only constants | **Exact** for normal constants; **Partial** overall | Full/debug/no-border **Missing**. |
| **PAR** | `vic.c` `vic_get_pixel_aspect` | `GetPixelAspectRatio` | **Exact** (formula) | Host wiring still must stay VIC-I-only. |
| **VIA core** | `core/viacore.c` (~1966 LOC) | `Via6522.cs` | **Partial** | Timers/IRQ used by lockstep. Class docs admit SR modes 001/011/100/101/111 are **stubs**; CB2 sample "defaults to 0". |
| **VIA1 board** | `vic20via1.c`: NMI, IEC PA write, joy, tape sense/motor, lightpen, userport | NMI wire + idle PA + joy bits via keyboard | **Partial** | Tape, userport PB/CB2, lightpen CA1, live `iec_pa_write` **Missing**. |
| **VIA2 board** | `vic20via2.c`: IRQ, keyboard, joy bit7, tape write, IEC CA2/CB2 outs | IRQ + keyboard matrix + joy right | **Partial** | Tape write bit, live IEC outs **Missing**. |
| **Keyboard/joy** | via1/via2 read hooks | `Vic20KeyboardMatrix` | **Partial** | Matrix path present; not full VICE joyport/userport model. |
| **IEC** | `vic20iec.c` `resolve_bus_signals` | `Vic20IecPort.IdlePortAInput = 0x7E` | **Exact** idle only; live **Missing** | Explicit idle-only attach in `ArchitectureBuilder.BuildVic20Machine`. Host `FileSystemIecDevice` is not VICE resolve. |
| **Datasette** | `vic20datasette.c` + via1/via2 tape | none on VIC-20 path | **Missing** | C64 builder wires `Datasette`; VIC-20 builder does not. |
| **IEEE** | `vic20ieeevia1/2.c` | none | **Missing** | |
| **Carts** | `cart/*.c` many cores | generic + FE3/Ultimem/MegaCart | **Stub** | Every cart file labels **MVP**; Ultimem "simplified"; FE3 flash program deferred; most VICE cart types absent. |
| **Snapshots** | `vic20-snapshot.c`, `vic-snapshot.c` | not VIC-20 complete | **Missing** | |
| **Machine glue** | `vic20.c`, resources, drive | `ArchitectureBuilder.BuildVic20Machine` | **Partial** | Dual VIA roles, RAM blocks, VIC attach: yes. Sound/tape/IEEE/live IEC: no. |

---

## Invent list (must not grow)

1. **Pre-cropped FB + raw `display_xstart` as canvas X**  
   `Mos6561.DrawRasterLine` uses `originX = _displayXStart` on a normal-border buffer (`EnsureFrameBufferSize`: 224/200 * `PixelWidth`). VICE draws at `draw_buffer_ptr + display_xstart` on the **full** line (`screen_width` 284/260 * `PixelWidth` in `vic-cycle.c` / `vic_set_geometry`), then crops. That crop equivalence is assumed, not proven for all XPOS.

2. **Simplified draw (no half-char / old colors)**  
   VICE `vic-draw.c` `draw()` special-cases first char when `mc_border`/`auxiliary`/`reverse` change, using `half_char_flag` and `old_*`. Managed always paints full cells with current border/bg/aux only.

3. **Eager `LatchColumns` live cols**  
   Managed sets `_textCols`/`_columns` immediately when pending > 0. VICE only sets `pending_text_cols` until `open_h` / `start_fetch`.

4. **Idle-only IEC as board truth**  
   `Vic20IecPort.AttachIdleVia1PortA` forces `$7E`-class idle bits; no `resolve_bus_signals` / drive participation.

5. **Cart MVP banking**  
   `Vic20Cartridge` ("MVP", max 16KB), `FinalExpansion3Cartridge` (MVP, flash program deferred), `UltimemCartridge` (MVP, 1MB vs VICE 16MB, simplified bank), `MegaCartCartridge` (MVP).

6. **Sound as store-only non-goal**  
   Explicit in `Mos6561.Write`: `$900A-$900E` stored; no `vic_sound_store`.

7. **`VicIStub`** still present (`VicIStub.cs`) as alternate non-port surface.

8. **`RenderNow` host pump**  
   Forces a synthetic full-frame tick loop for tests/hosts; not a VICE API. Acceptable as harness only if not claimed as chip fidelity.

9. **Via6522 SR T2/CB1 modes**  
   Documented stubs that never tick.

---

## False claims / overclaims

1. **"Everything has the EXACT SAME LOGIC as VICE" for VIC-20**  
   **False.** Audit bottom line + missing sound/tape/IEEE/live IEC/cart suite/interlace/half-char/snapshots.

2. **`Mos6561` cycle+draw is a faithful port of `vic-cycle.c` + `vic-draw.c` (not invent)**  
   **False.** Partial skeleton + invent crop/draw simplifications. Missing: interlace (`vic_cycle` lines 344-414), light pen (432-455), `vic_cycle_do_fetch` full map, half-char mid-line path, full line buffer, `vic_sound_store`, pot/lightpen regs.

3. **CPU 10s lockstep green implies video correctness**  
   **False.** `Vic20NativeLockstepTests.NativeXvic_Managed_VicI_Regs_Lockstep` only compares early power-on **register peeks** (static zeros + raster encode); comments say KERNAL video init is ~500k cycles later. No framebuffer / `cbuf`/`gbuf` / pixel lockstep. CPU A/X/Y/S/P/PC agreement does not exercise `DrawRasterLine`.

4. **Color RAM, open bus, dual VIA, idle IEC $7E, geometry, palette, PAR are Exact (as full-machine fidelity)**  
   **Overclaim if unqualified.** Individual rules can be Exact (color nybble, idle `$7E`, normal geometry numbers, PAR formula, PALette RGB). Dual VIA **roles** Exact; VIA **core/board** Partial. Idle IEC Exact does **not** make serial Exact. Open-bus is rule-level Partial/Exact-by-rule, not full mem.

5. **Carts are real ports, not MVP stubs**  
   **False.** Explicit MVP comments and reduced scope in all cart types; VICE has many more cores (`behrbonz`, `rabbit`, `superexpander`, `vic-fp`, `writenow`, MIDI, SID cart, IEEE cart, etc.) with **no** managed counterpart.

6. **Audit doc Exact labels that mislead when read as "machine Exact"**  
   - Stale: still lists `RenderCharacterFrame` as "Stub / Invented present path" while current display path is `DrawRasterLine` (EOF invent grid removed). That update is real, but status remains **Partial**, not Exact.  
   - Stale: "height fixed 8" is wrong now (`Write` sets 8|16).  
   - Correct and still damning: sound Missing, carts Stub, live IEC Missing, conclusion "Exact same logic" **false**.

7. **`Mos6561` summary comment: "cycle fetch + line draw ported from VICE"**  
   Overclaim: "ported" implies complete control-flow parity; evidence shows subset + invent.
